page.title: Freyr
page.meta_title: Freyr (Norse mythology) — Character, lore & connections | Ton-o-Lore
page.meta_description: Freyr, brother of Freyja, rules rain and good seasons. He gives away his sword for Gerd and so meets Surtr unarmed at Ragnarok. Related pages: Vanir.
page.content:
Vanir lord of harvest and peace, who dies without his sword.

How Freyr connects

  • Faction: Vanir — Freyr is a Vanir lord of harvest who lives in Asgard's circle.

What is Freyr?

Freyr, brother of Freyja, rules rain and good seasons. He gives away his sword for Gerd and so meets Surtr unarmed at Ragnarok.
